subject: general
question: Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence: He is so weak to **lift the box**.

options.text: that he cannot lift the box
that he could lift the box

solution:
The correct answer is '**that he cannot lift the box**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence is talking about his inability to lift the box due to weakness.
 
• The correct construction for expressing inability is "so weak that he cannot".
 
• **Option 1** correctly conveys the intended meaning.<
